loading.every_tunnel.tip.1: He can't see you. He doesn't need to. Sneak ({sneak}) to walk quietly.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.2: The flashlight ({flashlight}) is company property. The batteries are your problem.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.3: Running is fast. Running is loud. He prefers loud.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.4: Walls muffle sound. A wall between you and him is the best friend you will make tonight.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.5: Hold {use} to drink. Gulping is not quiet, so pick your moment.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.6: Sprinting and jumping wear you out. Out of breath, you pant, and panting carries.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.7: Jumping is loud. Landing is louder. Nobody down here is grading your parkour.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.8: When he stops breathing, he is listening. Do the same.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.9: Bare footsteps close by? Stand still. He walks to what he heard, not to where you are.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.10: Your heartbeat gets louder the closer he is. That is your heart. Probably.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.11: The flashlight's click makes a little noise. The light makes none. He has never complained about the light.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.12: Batteries and water bottles lie around the levels. Previous guards were careless. Or in a hurry.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.13: Thirst drains slowly, and faster while you sprint. Dehydration is not an approved reason to leave your post.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.14: Swapping a battery means unscrewing the cap. Do it somewhere quiet.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.15: Doors are loud. Open them only when you have to.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.16: Dying does not end your shift. It just starts the level over. Management appreciates your dedication.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.17: Lost? The arrows on the floor point the way. Someone painted them for a reason.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.18: If you hear something, say nothing.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.19: Noname Complex reminds all staff that the elevator music is not optional.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.20: Night shift perks: no customers, no traffic, and a very attentive coworker.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.21: The previous night guard left no notes. Or a forwarding address.
loading.every_tunnel.tip.22: Overtime is not paid. Survival is strongly encouraged.
